name: 針葉樹
notes: 2026-09-10 rework requested by the user: the v1 reconstruction's granular needle clumps looked unsettling. v2 uses smooth rounded foliage tiers.

Reference v2 is an art-directed Blender render (no imagegen available); the delivered mesh is TRELLIS-2 derived and reduced from the dense source (280,215 -> 12,609 triangles, p95 1.2 cm both directions).

Foliage texels were brought into a 0.16-0.36 luminance band so the lit crown tip no longer glows; bark texels untouched. Height 10 m, ground-centred pivot, so existing placements and scale rules are unchanged.
Views: qa/candidate-04 (6 directions), qa/lod1-04. LOD1 5,043 triangles used beyond 38 m; lod2 kept in work/ but not delivered (existing renderer uses one LOD).

provenance.referenceGenerator: Art-directed Blender 5.2 render (no local image generator on this host); see source/original/reference-v2.json
provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2 1024, seed 42 (work/trellis/dense-v2-res1024-seed0042.glb); source-derived weld + quadric reduction with retained UV/albedo; foliage-only albedo luminance calibration; no replacement geometry.
